candidateOccurrences.sourceText: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.
